pre.span:
Can we place m = 3 balls at a gap of at least 25?
If we place the first ball at 1, then the second ball should be placed after position 25.
We can only place it at 100.
Now, the third ball should be placed after 124, but we don't have any more positions left.
We can't place all the balls with a gap of 25.
Discard the right half search space.
